name: old city concrete pavement seen from above: long straight saw-cut slab joints (a bevel: shaded lip of the upper/left slab, dark groove, lit lip of the lower/right slab) laid as 2-4 tile panels in staggered rows, thin dark hairline cracks (finer and more broken than the joints), a few spalled holes showing earth along joints, weeds in joints, a chipped corner a heaved slab edge and damp stains; slab edges crumble into dirt (the south edge shows the slab thickness) and meet the asphalt road as a clean kerb; transparent decal over plain concrete
label: wasteland_ruins/slab-joints
